Q. Several years ago, X was visiting a child hospital with his team. Amongst a group of disabled children, one special boy, suffering from celebral palsy, was a huge fan of X. The child was 75-80% disabled and had lost all hopes walk again in his life.
X was unaware that the child had never stood up from his chair and walked in his life ever. Unknowingly, X went ahead and handed a bat to the boy, saying “if you played three balls with me, this bat is yours”. In a miraculous turn of events, that 11-year old boy, who hadn’t previously in his life, stood up after listening to the offer, endured pain, and played three balls of cricket with his idol. Who could be X, performing miracles like this as usual? ‎
